**Software Developer | Frontend Engineer | Biology & Technology Enthusiast**

## 👩🏽‍💻 About me 

I'm a Software Developer with **5+ years of experience building web applications**, specializing in frontend development with Vue 3, JavaScript and TypeScript.

My background combines Biology, Computational Biology and Software Engineering. My journey from science to technology has shaped the way I approach development: with curiosity, analytical thinking and a passion for solving problems.

I enjoy building scalable and maintainable applications, designing reusable components and working across the stack to turn ideas into functional products.
